title: Convex Auth — Multi-Provider Sign-in
description: @convex-dev/auth with Password (PBKDF2-SHA256 100k, self-hosted-friendly), Anonymous (guest), Google OAuth, and Resend magic-link. Ships a production SignInPage with i18n, prop-driven provider list, and split Login/Register tabs. No Clerk.

env.name: AUTH_RESEND_KEY
env.description: Resend API key for magic-link sender. Optional if only Password / Google / Anonymous used.

env.name: JWT_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Auth signing key. Self-hosted: also push via REST update_environment_variables.

env.name: SITE_URL
env.description: Public site origin for magic-link callback.

env.name: AUTH_GOOGLE_ID
env.description: Google OAuth client ID. Required only when Google provider enabled.
